assertions.name: N2_factor_equals_one_minus_u_squared
assertions.source: Structural: the N=2 ladder factor (1 - b²·ℏ_q⁴) IS literally (1 - u²) with u = b·ℏ_q². Therefore c_2 = -1 is not a fit; it is the (1 + c_2·u²) coefficient of the categorical N=2 correction. Boolean predicate: 1 iff sympy.simplify of the difference equals 0 (exact symbolic identity); expected = 1, tolerance = 0. The mpmath 50-dps value of the difference is recorded as data for inspection.

assertions.name: alpha_q0_matches_probe_n3_witness
assertions.source: α(q_0) computed from symbolic α = (z-1)·h/2 should match the value stored in q-beta-operator-valued-N3.witness.json (alpha field) to 50+ digits.

description: Symbolic chain α(q), b(q), α_eff(q), cos(α_eff(q)) for the Q_β precision ladder. Identifies the closed forms used in probe_q_beta_operator_valued_N3.py and shows that c_2 = -1 is structural (the (1 - b²·ℏ_q⁴) factor IS 1 + c_2·u² with u = b·ℏ_q²). Foundation for downstream c_3, c_4 categorical derivation. No fit. Reports the Q_β_CODATA residual after the N=2 partial-ladder Q_A · cos(α_eff) · (1-b²ℏ⁴) — what remains for c_3, c_4 to close categorically.
